supporting_evidence: existing canonical resource and active-effect ownership
master handoff resurrection and revival requirements
promoted_behavior: validate dead/eligible state, compute bounded restoration, keep combat state terminated, and atomically fan out restoration requests
assumptions: eligibility and restoration coefficients are policy inputs until production records are bound
all downstream sink commits are compensatable within the coordinator boundary
resurrection does not implicitly recreate the previous combat instance
safe_fallback: reject missing or unpromoted policy, expired eligibility, missing corpse, inconsistent room, or missing sink; reverse rollback partial commits
character_save_impact: persistence request emitted after death clearing and resource restoration
world_state_impact: destination movement and corpse/resource mutations occur only through committed sinks
